title: FX4 append-only history: a tool created mid-message
caption: The chat's tools are frozen at its first turn; CreateTool adds to the engine's live list, and every later request of the chat, its final one too, still sends the frozen list.

steps.text: first turn: Tools = a copy of the live list
request 1: system, the frozen tools, the messages
the new tool joins the live list only: "it is there in your next chat"
request 2: the same frozen tools, so the thinking stays valid
at the round limit: the final request reads TurnTools, tool_choice none
the turn, appended to the conversation
